snippet.title: Orebits - Official Demo Announcement Trailer - Idle Asteroid Extraction
snippet.description:
Smash through alien rock with oversized mining gear, collect rare ores and uncover strange secrets. Orebits is a gritty sci-fi idle game full of mystery and metal.

WISHLIST OREBITS on Steam: https://bit.ly/orebits

The Demo launches this summer (Q3 2025)!

Follow our game dev journey on: http://upgradedstudio.com
Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/BHAdsSmrPR
